en.stolen_vitality_failed: The price could not be paid in full; %{lead_name} pays the rest.
en.stolen_vitality_sacrifice_history: m_c paid the price for r_c's revival.
en.stolen_vitality_lead_history: No cat remained to give their life for m_c's.

sinkhole_base.zero: As the recent 12 moons come to an end, %{clan_name} breathes a sigh of relief. The force eating away at their numbers was merciful this time, allowing %{clan_name} to go another moon without extended sorrow.
sinkhole_base.one: Though %{clan_name} would've preffered to have all it's members living, the Clan counts themselves lucky. Only %{dead_name}'s life was lost.
sinkhole_base.some: %{dead_name} all lost their lives this moon to a mysterious force.
sinkhole_base.many: The cats of %{clan_name} stare to the stars, wondering what they possibly did to warrant such a cruel fate. %{dead_name} have all lost their lives, leaving the clan feeling broken.

en.sinkhole_history: A mysterious force took the life of m_c.
